name: docs
summary: Bring documentation in line with the code

steps.goal: List every doc surface and the commands, paths, flags and env vars each one claims
steps.verify: the list covers README, docs folder and changelog

steps.goal: Fix one doc surface so every claim matches the code
steps.verify: every command in the surface runs and every relative link resolves
steps.fan_out: one subtask per doc file or folder, ids write-<surface>

steps.goal: Run each command the updated docs show and check each claimed default against the code
